best: The 3V3 buck and the BQ25756 charger core are drawn as clean wired left-to-right paths with bootstrap, sense filters and the FB divider beside their pins.
worst: Cells and Gauge is mostly label-tied fragments: protection FETs, gate resistors, NTC jacks and the second-level fuse float apart, the gauge decoupling row labels each cap to an unrelated net, and text overlaps (FET_MID/CELL_P at Q101, J117/J120)
In the USB sheets the four-switch power stage is far from the charger controller and joined only by HG/LG/SW labels, and the antenna pi network on the MCU sheet is split between two distant spots
Space is poorly used: large empty areas on every sheet (3V3 lower half, MCU middle, USB right side) while some clusters are cramped and drawn very small
